# agents

The coordinator, and a producer and a strictly adversarial reviewer for each phase. Generated from [data/skill-principle-map.json](../data/skill-principle-map.json) and the skills by `scripts/build-agents.py`; run it after changing either.

Each agent's front matter declares `skills` (the skill folders it loads), `principles` (the principle IDs it can look up) and `loads` (the `SKILL.md` sections it takes from each skill). A phase loads the skills whose phase is that phase, plus the skills in the phase's category. Producers load each skill's Do and Don't lists together. Reviewers load only the adversarial reviewer checks and the Don't list.

The human talks only to the [coordinator](coordinator.md). Loops run on their own, and human feedback comes only at the end of the cycle, where it feeds the Learn skills through `/retro`.
